# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

Plasma can’t be made in a lab. So, people with rare and complex diseases rely on donors like you to
live fuller lives. Knowing you’re helping others is the best feeling in the world. And getting paid
for your time is a great way to boost your budget.

[BioLife Debit Card. When you donate, you'll receive compensation on a BioLife Debit Card that works
wherever Debit Mastercard is accepted.]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Welcome!

Just diagnosed? Don't panic!
We have 7 easy tips to help you all put together by Alphas who have been there, done that.

[READ MORE][17]

[[stick person panicking]][18]

[[DNA strand]][19]

What is Alpha-1?
Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (Alpha-1) is a genetic (inherited) condition – it is passed from
parents to their children through their genes. Alpha-1 may result in serious lung disease in adults
and/or liver disease at any age.

[LEARN MORE][20]

Who is [[A1ADSupport]][21]

We are a group of people diagnosed with Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency. This website was created to
store all of our favourite links and resources so we could easily share them with others.

If you have questions about Alpha-1, concerns about our website, or suggestions to help make it
better, we'd love to hear from you!

[MESSAGE US][22]

questions you may have regarding your medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice
or delay in seeking it because of something you have read in this group or on this site. If you do
not agree with your doctor, seek a 2nd medical opinion.*

# Welcome!

Just diagnosed? Don't panic!
We have 7 easy tips to help you all put together by Alphas who have been there, done that.

[READ MORE][17]

[[stick person panicking]][18]

[[DNA strand]][19]

What is Alpha-1?
Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (Alpha-1) is a genetic (inherited) condition – it is passed from
parents to their children through their genes. Alpha-1 may result in serious lung disease in adults
and/or liver disease at any age.

[LEARN MORE][20]

Who is [[A1ADSupport]][21]

We are a group of people diagnosed with Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency. This website was created to
store all of our favourite links and resources so we could easily share them with others.

If you have questions about Alpha-1, concerns about our website, or suggestions to help make it
better, we'd love to hear from you!

### Welcome to Accredo Specialty Pharmacy

Accredo supports people with complex and rare conditions through personalized specialty pharmacy
services. We help you get started, manage treatment, and stay on track—so you can focus on your
health.

Watch our video to learn more about how Accredo can help you manage your health.

## How to get started

### 1. [Call Accredo][37] to get started

We'll start your new patient enrollment.

### 2. Pick a Delivery Date

We'll contact you to arrange delivery to your home or doctor's office, as allowable by law.


### 3. Website Registration

You can easily manage your prescription orders online, [register now][38].

**Finding Copay Assistance Just Got Easier**

medication.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Accredo Specialty Pharmacy?
Accredo is a specialty pharmacy that helps people with complex and rare conditions manage their
treatment. We support patients from getting started through ongoing therapy. Learn more about some
of the [specialty conditions][43] Accredo supports.
How do I get started with Accredo?

Getting started usually begins when your provider sends us your prescription. Once it’s ready,
Accredo will contact you to help schedule delivery and guide you through next steps like
registration and managing your medication. You can also [contact Accredo][44] directly if you have
questions or need help getting started.

How do refills work with Accredo?

Once you’re a patient with Accredo, refills can be managed online, through our mobile app, or with
help from Accredo. We’ll also notify you when it’s time to refill.

How can I get help or contact Accredo?

If you have questions or need support, Accredo offers several ways to get help. Visit our [Contact
Us][45] or FAQ sections to find the option that works best for you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Accredo Specialty Pharmacy?
Accredo is a specialty pharmacy that helps people with complex and rare conditions manage their
treatment. We support patients from getting started through ongoing therapy. Learn more about some
of the [specialty conditions][43] Accredo supports.
How do I get started with Accredo?

Getting started usually begins when your provider sends us your prescription. Once it’s ready,
Accredo will contact you to help schedule delivery and guide you through next steps like
registration and managing your medication. You can also [contact Accredo][44] directly if you have
questions or need help getting started.

How do refills work with Accredo?

Once you’re a patient with Accredo, refills can be managed online, through our mobile app, or with
help from Accredo. We’ll also notify you when it’s time to refill.

How can I get help or contact Accredo?

If you have questions or need support, Accredo offers several ways to get help. Visit our [Contact
Us][45] or FAQ sections to find the option that works best for you.

Alphas Serving Alphas

Our AlphaNet Coordinators have Alpha-1, too. They're the heart of AlphaNet and are here to guide and
educate you on your journey with Alpha-1.

## Why Join AlphaNet?

As an AlphaNet subscriber you will have a Coordinator to guide you, access to the latest medical
information, and a portal to connect you with the AlphaNet community.
[Sign up for AlphaNet][77]

## Find a Coordinator

Your AlphaNet Coordinator is an Alpha just like you. They have a unique understanding of the issues
and concerns you may have living with Alpha-1.
[Find a Coordinator][78]
[What is Alpha-1?]

## What is Alpha-1?

What is Alpha-1? Who has it? What are the symptoms? Is there a treatment? Get your questions
answered.
[What is Alpha-1?][79]

### Working together behind the scenes

Your AlphaNet Coordinator is an Alpha just like you. They have a unique understanding of the issues
and concerns you may have living with Alpha-1.

* [Find your local AlphaNet Coordinator][81]

Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency is one of the most common serious genetic disorders worldwide.
Discover how AlphaNet is helping Alphas lead better quality lives.

## Welcome to the Alpha-1 Alleles Website

### Our Purpose:

Alpha-1 Alleles is a website that provides information for patients, healthcare professionals, and
the general public about specific variants in the Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
(Alpha-1, AATD, SERPINA1 ) gene. For each variant or variant combination included in our database,
the website will provide known information about:

* Whether the variant or variant combination contributes to Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
* The biological mechanism and effect on AAT level
* Association with lung disease
* Association with liver disease
* Healthcare provider information and literature references
Information on the Alpha-1 Alleles website is being updated as further data becomes available.

### What this site is intended to do:

This website provides information for members of the general public, including Alpha-1 patients and
their family members, about what is currently known about specific genetic variants related to
Alpha-1. Patients and their family members are encouraged to review our [FAQs][1] page, and learn
more about Alpha-1 at the [Alpha-1 Foundation website][2] . This website also provides more in-depth
research-related information for health care professionals and researchers.  

### What this site is NOT intended to do:

This website is not intended to help diagnose anyone with Alpha-1.
The information contained on this website should not be used to predict the clinical course of
individual patients. 
This website is not intended to provide medical advice to individual patients. 
This website is not intended to provide information about conditions other than lung and liver
disease that may be associated with Alpha-1.

Note: If you have questions about any of the information contained in this website, please consult
your doctor.

## Site Usage Agreement

Before you may search the database, you must read and agree to the following statements:

* This website uses cookies to remember your agreement on this device.
* The information contained in this website is for educational purposes only.
* An interpretation of a particular variant’s chance of causing Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is
  challenging and may be different for different individuals.
* We encourage you to discuss the information contained in this website with your doctor or genetic
  counselor before making any medical or reproductive decisions.

# AlphaNet *Canada*

## Improving the lives of Alphas

Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (Alpha-1) is a genetic (inherited) condition – it is passed from
parents to their children through their genes. Alpha-1 may result in serious lung disease in adults
and/or liver disease at any age.

[READ MORE][53]

3%

Up to 3% of all people diagnosed with COPD may have undetected Alpha-1.

## *& Angela Diano*

## Dr. Kenneth Chapman
## *& Angela Diano*

directs **AlphaNet Canada** in sharing research and disease management information with Canadian
patients. He works alongside **Angela Diano**, Executive Director, who is committed to ensuring
equitable access to testing, treatment, and support. Together, they strive to improve the lives of
those affected by **alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency** in Canada, supported by AlphaNet Canada

## How does AlphaNet
## *Canada help Alphas?*

By staying connected and subscribing to AlphaNet Canada, patients play a vital role in helping us
identify the number of Canadians diagnosed with Alpha-1 and better understand your specific needs.
This information empowers us to advocate more effectively on your behalf, especially when engaging
with provincial and territorial governments to secure access to new and innovative therapies for
Alpha-1 patients across Canada.

Through our tailored disease management services, we offer patients a comprehensive range of
resources, including essential information, education,
and personalized support. Our goal is to empower and guide them every step of the way on their
healthcare journey.

We actively engage with physicians and the broader medical community, serving as a vital resource
for up-to-date information and fostering collaboration to improve patient care.

We offer comprehensive health system navigation, empowering patients to make informed decisions
about their treatment options and receive the best possible care.
